Apple's $0.27 payment lands Mon Nov 16, but its ex-date (Nov 12) is already past. Nvidia has not yet declared its next ex-date; a December declaration is plausible but not a date. SPY and QQQ December distributions are undeclared. Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the window, Tue Nov 17 after close, with consensus of $2.49 EPS and about a 9.7% move implied by options, against a -2.8% average signed earnings-day move over the last four reports (all four down). The Huang resignation is verified by the SEC Form 8-K filed Nov 12 (event Nov 11): Kress is interim CEO, Jones is board chair. desks.Futures: The IEA flipped to a fourth-quarter surplus call on Nov 13 (about 1.7 million barrels per day) and crude fell about 3% intraday, WTI $85.39 and Brent $92.19, even as fresh Hormuz tanker incidents continued and flows recover. Distillate sits about 8% below its five-year average, and the Nov 10 WASDE tightened corn and soybean ending stocks below trade expectations. Gold slid to $3,853.50, its lowest since September 2025, tracking the same hike repricing Desk 7 is watching. Next: EIA petroleum report Wed Nov 18, OPEC+ meeting Nov 29.

headline: Daily research brief — Monday, November 16

items.detail: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the next two weeks, Tue Nov 17 after close, with consensus of $2.49 EPS. Options imply a move of about 9.7% (Nov 20 weekly straddle $15.10 / $156.14; about 8.4% on the Nov 18 straddle), roughly 3.5 times the average realized earnings-day move of the last four reports, which averaged -2.8% signed — all four down. The stock is down 31.5% since the last print. This is the first report under interim CEO Colette Kress. The Huang resignation claim holds: the SEC Form 8-K filed Nov 12 confirms the board accepted Jen-Hsun Huang's resignation as President, CEO and director effective Nov 11, with Kress named interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones named board chair. Premium into a binary event is to be avoided.
items.title: Nvidia reports Tue Nov 17 after close — the only watchlist earnings in the window, with a 9.7% move implied

items.detail: The call is unchanged: a 25 basis point hike on Dec 9, 5 HIKE / 1 CUT / 4 NEUTRAL across the ten core indicators. The 10-year Treasury reached 5.15% on Nov 13, up 17 basis points since Nov 10, and the 2s10s slope widened to +27 basis points. Kalshi now prices total hike at $0.96 (was $1.00) and the more-than-25bp tail at $0.06, halved from $0.12 on Nov 13 — markets now agree with FedWatch on about a 95% hike and a roughly 6% tail. Governor Waller's trigger fired — October core CPI printed +0.296% month over month, at his 'around 0.3%' threshold — and the market faded it anyway, with the more-than-25bp price falling after the print. At assumed perpetual growth of 3.00%, the Gordon multiple falls to 46.51x from 50.51x, down 7.9% since Nov 10; re-anchor the discount rate to 5.15%.
items.title: Rates: Desk 7 unchanged — 25bp hike call for Dec 9, 10-year at 5.15%

items.detail: The IEA's Nov 13 Oil Market Report calls a fourth-quarter surplus of about 1.7 million barrels per day, the first since the Iran war began, and crude fell hard even as fresh Hormuz tanker incidents continued — WTI $85.39 and Brent $92.19 intraday. The operative tension is crude-loose versus diesel-tight: distillate stocks rose 4.1 million barrels in the week to Nov 6 but sit about 8% below their five-year average. The Nov 10 WASDE tightened corn and soybean ending stocks below trade expectations (corn 1.758 billion bushels, soybeans 300 million). Next EIA weekly report is Wed Nov 18 at 10:30 ET.
